Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Quang Pham
Message:
Add root admin auto-creation and startup scripts

Implements automatic creation of a root administrator account with full permissions on first login. Adds supporting documentation (ROOT_ADMIN_GUIDE.md, ROOT_ADMIN_SETUP_COMPLETE.md), quick start scripts (START_BACKEND.bat, STOP_BACKEND.bat), and updates AuthFunction.cs to assign special claims to the root admin. Updates README.md and adds test/demo files for admin and CORS functionality. Registers DatabaseInitializer service in Program.cs.

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Quang Pham
Message:
feat(auth): Implement Phase 4 JWT authentication (T075-T082)

Backend Implementation Complete:
- JWT token service with HS256 signing (JwtTokenService.cs)
- Authentication middleware with token validation (AuthenticationMiddleware.cs)
- AuthFunction with login/refresh/logout endpoints (AuthFunction.cs)
- User profile creation on first login
- Token refresh with rotation (7-day expiry)
- Logout with refresh token invalidation
- Authenticated rate limiting (500 req/min)
- Application Insights telemetry for all auth events

API Endpoints:
- POST /api/v1/auth/login - Email login, returns JWT + refresh token
- POST /api/v1/auth/refresh - Refresh access token
- POST /api/v1/auth/logout - Invalidate refresh token
- GET /api/v1/users/me - Get authenticated user profile

Storage:
- Users stored in Blob Storage (users/users.json)
- Refresh tokens stored with 7-day expiration
- User model includes RefreshToken, RefreshTokenExpiry

Testing:
 Login creates user and returns tokens
 Token validation in middleware populates context
 GET /users/me returns profile for authenticated users
 Token refresh rotates tokens successfully
 Logout invalidates refresh tokens
 Application Insights tracks all auth events

Build: Success (7 warnings, 0 errors)
Phase 4 Progress: 8/18 tasks (44%)
Next: Frontend OAuth UI (T083-T085) + Azure AD B2C (T074)
